detail:
Two residuals of the lock-triage-r2 UNSURE keys R2|fn-pgs-fill-realize|E:fnn-extent-pread and R2|fn-pgs-fill-realize|O:fnn-extent-pread (and the shared pread keys on that chain).
(1) E path, latent crash: fnn-owner-limit-serialized (admin.lisp:534) holds O and E (fnn-with-observed-mutex *fnn-extent-lock*) and calls fn-owner-limit-use (owner-host.lisp:1311) -> fn-owner-record-debt (:1295) -> fn-hist-debt-carried (books/history-columns-store.lisp:106). Its invalid-cache fallback `(fn-cvec-record-debt (fn-sf-records (fn-sn-files s)))` -> fn-sfr-list -> fn-hrs-disk-history -> ... -> fn-hrs-fill-run -> fn-pgs-fill-realize, which re-takes *fnn-extent-lock* with a non-recursive with-mutex (host/native/extent.lisp:1717, :wait-p t) while limit-serialized already holds E: a recursive-lock error if ever reached. It is unreachable in steady state because the carried cache is set at install (owner-host.lisp:642-645) and by recovery (books/owner-recovery-retain.lisp:56-57), and the arm needs (consp cache), (car cache) <= count to fail. Not proven in ACL2 here; the valid-cache lemmas exist (fn-cvec-full-debt-cache-is-valid) but do not state that the arm is dead.
(2) O path: fn-host-hist-sync (host/store-node-host.lisp:101-106) takes the whole-history disk load (fn-hist-refresh with reload -> fn-sf-records -> disk pages -> fn-pgs-fill-realize preads) on the first call after an open (fn-store-sn-hist-reload set only by fn-store-sn-reset at open: store-open-host.lisp:601, store-write-host.lisp:1204). The first call is meant to be the history-root row loop at install (owner.lisp:1630 fnn-owner-history-root-maintain -> history-root.lisp:88 refresh -> fn-owner-hroot-row, history-root-host.lisp:77) before serving. But history-root.lisp:96-99 returns before any row when fn-owner-hroot-begin does not answer :building. Then the first runtime fn-host-hist-sync (e.g. fnn-owner-inspect-request admin.lisp:394 -> fn-store-sn-lookup-foundp, store-node-host.lisp:1558; or the feed reply, owner-host.lisp:5355) loads the whole history from disk inside the owner quantum (O held; fill-realize does not hold E at the pread there). The fn-owner-install-profile fold (owner-host.lisp:640) reads fn-sf-records directly and does NOT sync the stobj, so it does not consume the flag.
fix: (1) Prove in ACL2 that fn-hist-debt-carried's fallback arm is dead for every owner state limit-use runs in (the cache-valid invariant: set at install, kept by commit and recovery, car <= count), or make fn-pgs-fill-realize not re-take E when the thread already holds it (take the descriptor and base before the E region, or look up under the caller's lock). (2) Make the first stobj sync an explicit startup step before serving (call fn-host-hist-sync from install regardless of fn-owner-hroot-begin's answer), or declare the first-use load as a startup-phase exception and prove the flag consumed there.
scenario: (1) any invalid or missing carried debt cache during a live `store limit' faults with a recursive-lock error instead of answering. (2) install's history-root refresh refuses before its first row: the first inspect, lookup or feed reply after start reads the entire on-disk history under O.
title: History page fill (fn-pgs-fill-realize) re-takes the extent mutex non-recursively under limit-serialized, and the whole-history disk load can run under the owner mutex
